_comment: Shared contract for the session-window planner. Asserted by tests/windowplan.test.js (GNOME lib/pure.js) and ClaudeUsageCoreTests/WindowPlannerTests (macOS WindowPlanner.swift). Change a port and this file together, never one alone.

plan.name: two pings cover a 9h day completely
one ping cannot cover a 9h day
asking for more windows than the day can use is capped

evaluate.name: naive 09:00 start leaves the afternoon uncovered
overlapping pings are unioned, never summed
a spread schedule beats a redundant one
